layers.name: Formal semantic contract and exact projection proof
Finite recursive and condition meaning proofs
Measured hardening and human use review

tasks.title: Formalize successor meanings and independently required statements
inputs: Current F0 semantic definitions and audited statement types
algorithm: Define graph-member contextual conformance and exact target-kind meaning independently from a projector.
Specify fixed-domain recursive ordinary extension and explicit condition-status meanings.
Fix projection, existential view, support, closure, old-model expansion and root-boundary theorem types; check well-formed Lean types.
Record choices for target-kind view, domain growth and context/epoch; never define correctness as checker success.
edge_cases: No conformance or no initial seed
acceptance_criteria: Independent definitions and required types compile under the pinned policy.
Every new guarantee and assumption has a requirement ID; deferred negation has no runtime rule.
Source meanings and proposed defaults are reviewable before schema/runtime changes.
validation: Lean type-check required definitions/statements without custom axioms or sorry.
Review definitions against concrete rich and collapsed examples.

working_units.title: Formalize successor meanings and independently required statements
verification: Lean type-check required definitions/statements without custom axioms or sorry.
Review definitions against concrete rich and collapsed examples.

tasks.title: Build semantic requirement ledger and premise-removal challenges
algorithm: Map each selected source requirement to an independent predicate, statement, assumption or unsupported status.
Attach positive/negative cases and applicable mutant removing exactly one required condition.
Run named controls; retain countermodels that show why a premise is necessary.
Keep every inherited unsupported item until its own source/meaning evidence exists.
acceptance_criteria: No selected requirement is silently unclassified.
All applicable named mutants are detected; exclusions have explicit reasons.
The ledger distinguishes structural checks, supplied truth and semantic theorems.
validation: Validate requirement references and current source bindings.
Run the finite semantic witness/mutation suite; record exact failed property and profile.

working_units.title: Build semantic requirement ledger and premise-removal challenges
verification: Validate requirement references and current source bindings.
Run the finite semantic witness/mutation suite; record exact failed property and profile.

tasks.title: Prove the contextual graph-to-fact bridge
algorithm: Enumerate member conformance assertions of a graph satisfying the selected invariant.
Project exact subject/target references and scope, plus checked target-kind observations.
Build complete support sets for deduplicated initial atoms and derive the unary existential view.
Prove soundness, completeness, support validity and exact existential correspondence.
acceptance_criteria: Required independent theorem types are proved and audited.
A specific contract/scope query cannot use only unary conformance.
v1 meanings are unchanged and domain/profile differences are explicit.
validation: Fresh kernel replay of required statements and axiom/dependency closure.
Execute wrong-contract, wrong-scope, wrong-kind, nonmember and duplicate-support controls.

working_units.title: Prove the contextual graph-to-fact bridge
verification: Fresh kernel replay of required statements and axiom/dependency closure.
Execute wrong-contract, wrong-scope, wrong-kind, nonmember and duplicate-support controls.

tasks.title: Prove finite recursive fresh-definition expansion
algorithm: Fix old interpretation for an arbitrary old semantic model.
Iterate only fresh ordinary heads over the finite typed universe with positive old/fresh bodies.
Prove monotonicity, stabilization, closure, old-reduct equality and every-old-model expansion.
Check all producer roles and reject old/protected heads or changed domain/roots.
acceptance_criteria: Every old model expands under independently checked profile hypotheses.
Unseeded cycles create no facts; protected/root inventories are preserved.
Unsupported domain/old-head changes remain blocked with precise reasons.
validation: Audit exact general conservativity/termination statements in Lean.
Run multi-step/cycle and hostile old-head/root controls.

working_units.title: Prove finite recursive fresh-definition expansion
verification: Audit exact general conservativity/termination statements in Lean.
Run multi-step/cycle and hostile old-head/root controls.

tasks.title: Formalize interpreted conditions and stress source mappings
algorithm: Define exact source qualifier interpretation witnesses and context bindings.
Separate holds, explicit does-not-hold and unknown; positive conclusions require checked holds.
Map every selected field into typed input or explicit unsupported/opaque status.
Define/prove supported mapping and snapshot soundness without asserting external authenticity.
acceptance_criteria: All fields and assumptions are accounted for.
Missing interpretation remains unknown rather than false or permission.
No unsupported chain/override meaning is silently supplied.
validation: Compile independent mapping/condition statement targets and prove supported correspondence.
Review field maps against literal source shapes and typed stress records.

working_units.title: Formalize interpreted conditions and stress source mappings
verification: Compile independent mapping/condition statement targets and prove supported correspondence.
Review field maps against literal source shapes and typed stress records.

tasks.title: Align successor transports and implement checked projection
inputs: S02 formal projector and support proofs
Main and stress current CLI contracts
algorithm: Version contextual input/output/profile transports without changing reserved v1 contracts.
Strictly decode, bind sources and generate typed projection input.
Check projection/support witnesses against exact graph/profile identity.
Publish explicit domain, target-kind, theorem and trust requirements.
edge_cases: Older v1 receipt used for v2
acceptance_criteria: Transport outputs agree with formal projection on selected controls.
Missing projection proof/support or changed identities block result readiness.
Adapter remains a tested trust boundary unless equivalence is separately proved.
validation: Schema positive/negative validation and fresh kernel differential projection checks.
Retain v1 fixture regression and reject old/new profile substitution.

working_units.title: Align successor transports and implement checked projection
verification: Schema positive/negative validation and fresh kernel differential projection checks.
Retain v1 fixture regression and reject old/new profile substitution.

tasks.title: Integrate recursive profile and complete new obligation inventory
inputs: S03 actual recursion hypotheses and proofs
algorithm: Classify actual old/fresh vocabulary, rules, domain and roots.
Independently generate the complete new required obligations, including projection and actual recursion hypotheses.
Check certificates, complete closures, exact witnesses and general expansion evidence.
Aggregate only allowed current evidence methods; preserve unknown/unsupported/stale outcomes.
acceptance_criteria: Recursive ordinary cases become supported only with the new proof profile.
Actual hypotheses/witnesses and general theorems are separately discharged.
No assumption that the new inventory must still contain exactly 15 obligations.
validation: Fresh complete recursive proposal replay plus missing/wrong/stale evidence controls.
Independently compare required versus returned obligation IDs.

working_units.title: Integrate recursive profile and complete new obligation inventory
verification: Fresh complete recursive proposal replay plus missing/wrong/stale evidence controls.
Independently compare required versus returned obligation IDs.

tasks.title: Implement explicit registry-to-stress adapters
inputs: S04 field mappings and condition proofs
Typed stress CLIs and assessment sources
algorithm: Resolve exact registry/source and interpretation record versions.
Check endpoint kinds and every mapped qualifier; create typed stress inputs with exact snapshot binding.
Evaluate only supported direct delegation and fixed norm profiles.
Export scoped condition/norm facts with checked support and residual assumptions.
acceptance_criteria: Exact mappings are checked; registry semantic ledger only advances for discharged named items.
Typed profile successes cannot be generalized to unmapped legacy inputs.
Inheritance does not produce fulfillment or admission.
validation: Differential mapping controls against typed stress examples and source records.
Kernel witness/revocation/origin controls plus strict interpretation transports.

working_units.title: Implement explicit registry-to-stress adapters
verification: Differential mapping controls against typed stress examples and source records.
Kernel witness/revocation/origin controls plus strict interpretation transports.

tasks.title: Publish explanations and current capability/status documentation
inputs: Current baseline receipts, pending human review
algorithm: Render exact assertion, assessment, target kind, scope, projection, rule substitution and theorem scope.
Display supplied-truth assumptions and lossy unary views explicitly.
Generate separate machine/acceptance/human/authority statuses and link historical designs.
Describe main and stress exit conventions and optional future HTTP design accurately.
edge_cases: Saved machine pass with pending human review
acceptance_criteria: Explanations identify concrete source and blocking obligation without upgrading readiness.
Current index contradicts no accepted current operation/status evidence.
No historical source/accepted export is silently rewritten.
validation: Check explanation fixtures/links and exact currentness/status mappings.
Conduct usability review with the wrong-contract/scope example.

working_units.title: Publish explanations and current capability/status documentation
verification: Check explanation fixtures/links and exact currentness/status mappings.
Conduct usability review with the wrong-contract/scope example.

tasks.title: Qualify composed contexts and successor shadow baselines
algorithm: Register a newly checked successor snapshot and its exact semantic profile/manifest.
Bind proposals to that explicit before-state and generated evidence dependencies.
Recheck full required evidence and all source/context/epoch identities before shadow replacement.
Apply a second supported edit only after the successor baseline is independently qualified.
edge_cases: Old baseline receipt after first apply
acceptance_criteria: Two supported shadow edits use two valid exact baselines with no transplanted old receipts.
Every drift case blocks application; authority posture remains none.
Local cooperative locking is described with its actual limits.
validation: Run two-step candidate application and review-to-apply drift controls.
Inspect retained immutable before/after snapshots and complete obligation outcomes.

working_units.title: Qualify composed contexts and successor shadow baselines
verification: Run two-step candidate application and review-to-apply drift controls.
Inspect retained immutable before/after snapshots and complete obligation outcomes.

tasks.title: Qualify end-to-end trust boundaries and regression
inputs: All integrated profiles, proofs, transports and baseline evidence
algorithm: Replay independent exact theorem catalog and actual model/projection witnesses.
Exercise hostile transports, role substitution, stale imports/sources and missing hard obligations.
Compare every retained v1 guarantee with scoped successor behavior.
Record tested versus proved decoder/evaluator boundaries and remaining unsupported semantics.
edge_cases: Supplied accepted flag falsely described as authentication
acceptance_criteria: No successor guarantee is based on metadata flags alone.
Every retained guarantee and new requirement has current scoped evidence.
Trust assumptions and unsupported legacy items remain explicit.
validation: Run meaningful formal/transport/workflow hostile controls for changed surfaces.
Audit exact proof statements, source closure, axioms and regression mapping.

working_units.title: Qualify end-to-end trust boundaries and regression
verification: Run meaningful formal/transport/workflow hostile controls for changed surfaces.
Audit exact proof statements, source closure, axioms and regression mapping.

tasks.title: Measure stage costs and richer-profile workload growth
algorithm: Instrument hashing, compilation, projection, grounding, saturation, proof/witness checks and application.
Vary domain size, arity, variables/rule, edges, chain/cycle depth and dependency size.
Separate cold/warm process costs and report exactly observed resources.
Select declared budgets/optimization target from measured dominant stages.
edge_cases: Small graph with large registry compile
acceptance_criteria: Recorded measurements distinguish stage costs and execution limits from logical verdicts.
No unsupported throughput/scale promise is made.
A reviewable bottleneck selection precedes optimization.
validation: Run declared finite benchmark workloads with stage timing/RSS/work counters.
Check exhausted jobs return unknown and cannot issue complete readiness.

working_units.title: Measure stage costs and richer-profile workload growth
verification: Run declared finite benchmark workloads with stage timing/RSS/work counters.
Check exhausted jobs return unknown and cannot issue complete readiness.

tasks.title: Optimize measured bottlenecks with equivalence evidence
inputs: Reference grounding/closure and immutable compilation policy
algorithm: Enumerate sort-compatible substitutions and index matching only where measurement warrants.
Prove reference/optimized grounding or closure equality for the declared profile.
If compilation reuse is selected, validate source/import/toolchain/policy identities before reuse.
Retain uncached full replay and fresh pre/post application checks; no readiness cache.
edge_cases: Changed import with unchanged display version
acceptance_criteria: Selected optimization has exact equivalence or remains disabled.
Invalid/stale artifacts cannot authorize proof or readiness.
Measured before/after results use the same workload and scoped guarantees.
validation: Kernel equivalence proof plus finite differential/hostile optimization controls.
Repeat only relevant measured benchmark and drift cases.

working_units.title: Optimize measured bottlenecks with equivalence evidence
verification: Kernel equivalence proof plus finite differential/hostile optimization controls.
Repeat only relevant measured benchmark and drift cases.

tasks.title: Run representative rich-profile shadow pilot
inputs: Qualified optimized or reference fallback runtime
S01 requirement cases and explanation fixtures
algorithm: Run actual rich conformance, recursive chain/cycle, mapped delegation/inheritance and two-step shadow cases.
Exercise wrong context/target, missing interpretation, stale evidence and unknown witness/resource cases.
Publish concise worked explanations, complete hard inventories, measured costs and exact remaining limits.
Request actual human meaning, diagnostic and bounded-use assessment only after concrete evidence exists.
edge_cases: Machine pass misread as human approval
acceptance_criteria: Machine results cover supported positives and meaningful negative/unknown/stale paths.
Human feedback is recorded only from actual responses.
Any revisions remain explicit and do not relabel v1 R06/G4 as complete.
validation: Execute declared representative local workflows and validate saved outcome/provenance bindings.
Review worked examples against requirement IDs and returned explanations.

working_units.title: Run representative rich-profile shadow pilot
verification: Execute declared representative local workflows and validate saved outcome/provenance bindings.
Review worked examples against requirement IDs and returned explanations.

tasks.title: Review successor use and retain original unresolved human gates
algorithm: Audit each successor task/requirement and retained layer guarantee.
Evaluate actual semantic and diagnostic feedback separately from proof validity.
Record qualified/deferred use and unsupported profiles without deployment authority.
Keep original human gates pending unless a direct response expressly assesses their reviewed artifacts.
edge_cases: Scope of new response differs from v1 review
acceptance_criteria: Final use recommendation cites real human feedback and current scoped evidence.
Missing/revision feedback leaves use qualification pending, not fabricated.
No live authority/runtime publication or completion claim follows from this review alone.
validation: Read-only exact acceptance/evidence audit and direct feedback review.
Verify all relevant source/proposal/feedback bindings before a candidate recommendation.

working_units.title: Review successor use and retain original unresolved human gates
verification: Read-only exact acceptance/evidence audit and direct feedback review.
Verify all relevant source/proposal/feedback bindings before a candidate recommendation.

deferred: General negation and closed-world completeness profile
Generated function terms and unrestricted arithmetic
External issuer/clock authentication and live authority transactions
dependency_policy: Finish-to-start on current exact scoped evidence. Parallelizable branches do not authorize agent spawning. Current proposal creates no implementation or acceptance.
scheduling: Topological waves only; no fabricated durations/throughput targets.
